versions.changelog:
Initial release of video-to-screenplay.

- Converts video/audio transcripts into original screenplays using a two-stage LLM pipeline (story extraction, then screenplay generation).
- Supports input from transcript (SRT), audio, or video files.
- Outputs both human-readable (.md) and Fountain format screenplays, plus transcript and story DNA (themes, characters, conflicts).
- Integrates with six LLM providers (deepseek, kimi, zhipu, longcat, google, agnes) and supports CPU/GPU for transcription.
- Command-line options for genre, target duration, provider/model selection, and extract-only mode.
